verdicts.reason: The two are almost the same layout. In both, the 'EVENT MANAGEMENT' eyebrow has been pulled away from the headline and left as a tiny red label in the top-left corner. The whole left half is sparse confetti with no content, while both owls and the three-line headline are packed into the right half, so the banner is badly lopsided and has a big empty area. B scales the owls and headline up slightly, which pushes 'KIDS BIRTHDAY STUDIO' tighter against the right edge and squeezes the gap between the brown owl and the 'K' even more. A keeps a bit more right margin, so it is marginally less cramped.
